title: Verify that a valid JPG thumbnail under 2MB uploads and saves successfully

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
Upload a 1MB JPG file as Thumbnail Image
steps.expected: JPG file uploads and preview displays

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Item saves successfully with the JPG thumbnail stored

title: Verify that a valid PNG thumbnail under 2MB uploads and saves successfully

steps.action: Open Create Album screen
Upload a 1MB PNG file as Thumbnail Image
steps.expected: PNG file uploads and preview displays

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Item saves successfully with the PNG thumbnail stored

title: Verify that the Thumbnail Image persists after save and reload

steps.action: Save a video with a valid JPG thumbnail
Navigate away from the edit screen
Re-open the video's Edit screen
steps.expected: The same thumbnail image still displays in the Edit screen and on the Home Page card

title: Verify that the system's handling when both Video File and Embed URL are provided together

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
Upload a valid Video File AND enter a valid Embed URL
steps.expected: Both a file and a URL are provided

steps.action: Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: One deterministic outcome occurs: either the save is blocked with a clear 'provide only one' validation message, or the save succeeds using one clearly defined source (documented behavior, not silent/undefined) — no crash, no corrupted record

title: Verify that an invalid Embed URL format is rejected

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
Enter `notaurl` in the Embed URL field
Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating the Embed URL must be a valid URL; item is not saved

title: Verify that the Video File/Embed URL value persists after save and reload

steps.action: Save a video with a valid Embed URL
Navigate away from the edit screen
Re-open the video's Edit screen
steps.expected: The same Embed URL still displays in the Edit screen

title: Verify that a valid Publication Date is accepted and saved

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
Enter Publication Date = 18/04/2026
Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Item saves successfully with Publication Date stored as 18 Apr 2026

title: Verify that an invalid Publication Date format is rejected

steps.action: Open Create Video screen
Enter Publication Date = 32/13/2026
Fill remaining mandatory fields and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with a validation error indicating the date is invalid; item is not saved
